violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: in the walk-in refrigerator, sour cream (46F) and cooked pork (49F) were not temping properly at time of inspection.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC THAT ALL COLD HOLDING FOODS NEED TO BE AT A TEMPERATURE OF 41F OR BELOW TO PREVENT THE POTENTIAL GROWTH OF FOOD BORNE ILLNESSES. PIC THREW AWAY BOTH THE SOUR CREAM AND COOKED PORK THAT WAS NOT TEMPING PROPERLY.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: the 3DR prep top(50F) and the 2DR flat top(50F) under the grill were not working properly at time of inspection and could not hold a temp of 41F or below.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. PIC IS AWARE OF THE BROKEN UNITS AND HAVE PUT IN SERVICE REQUESTS FOR BOTH AND SMALL PORTIONS OF FOOD ARE IN ICE BATHS IN EACH UNIT. EHS WILL CONDUCT A FOLLOW-UP ONCE UNITS ARE FIXED.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Access to Handwashing Sink
violations.observation: The handwashing facility located to the right of the dry stock storage and the hand washing sink on the make line were blocked, preventing access by employees for easy handwashing.
violations.corrective_action: A hand washing sink shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for employee use. PIC UNDERSTANDS THAT HAND SINKS CAN NEVER BE BLOCKED AND ALWAYS BE AVAILABLE FOR EMPLOYEES TO WASH HANDS AND PREVENT POTENTIAL CONTAMINATION. PIC REMOVED THE OBJECTS BLOCKING THE TWO HAND SINKS.

violations.title: Eggs Stored at 45F or less
violations.observation: Observed an ambient air temperature above 45F in the following refrigeration unit holding raw shells eggs: raw shell eggs were being stored in a cardboard box next to the flat top grill with no temperature control.
violations.corrective_action: Shell eggs that have not been treated to destroy Salmonella shall be stored in refrigerated equipment that maintains an ambient temperature of 45F or less. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC THE IMPORTANCE OF MAKING SURE EGGS ARE BEING KEPT AT AN AMBIENT TEMP OF 45F OR BELOW. PIC TOLD EHS THEY HAD ONLY RECENTLY BEEN MOVED TO NEXT TO THE FLAT TOP. PIC MADE EMPLOYEE MOVE THE EGGS TO A COLD HOLDING UNIT IN ODER TO COOL THE EGGS TO THE PROPER TEMP.
